title: CCI Quick Grant
who: Any artist living full-time in California
what: Up to $600 for workshops, conference or festival registration, a coach or consultant, memberships, travel, and the childcare you need to attend. Apply by the 15th of any month; hear back by the 15th of the next.

title: Theatre Bay Area CA$H grants
who: Individual theatre artists and small theatre companies in the Bay Area
what: $2,500 (CA$H Creates) or $5,000 (CA$H Performs). Companies must have budgets under $100,000. No extensions.

title: Kala Art Institute Fellowship
who: Artists in any medium, local or not
what: $3,000 plus a one- to nine-month studio residency at Kala in Berkeley, a class or workshop, and a group show. Applications open December 2026 for the July 2027 to June 2028 residency year.
cost: Application fee not stated on the page; check before applying

title: Theatre Bay Area General Auditions 2027
who: Actors, union and non-union, with a free TBA individual membership
what: Live auditions Feb 6 and 7, 2027 at A.C.T.'s Strand Theater in San Francisco, in front of Bay Area theatre companies. Slots are limited; apply by Nov 19.

title: Bay Area makerspaces (Eddie's List)
who: Anyone who needs tools, a shop, or a workbench
what: A running list of makerspaces, library tool programs, and shared workshops around the Bay.

title: CCSF Free City
who: San Francisco residents taking credit classes at City College
what: Covers the $46-per-unit enrollment fee for any course of study: jewelry, film, acting, music, and more. Other small fees (health, registration, materials) still apply.

title: Discover & Go (SF Public Library)
who: San Francisco residents with a library card
what: Reserve free passes to museums, science centers, theaters, and other venues through the library. Two active reservations at a time; new passes release on the 1st of each month.

title: Beginner Bay Area Street Dance Resource Guide
what: Decentered Arts' guide to classes, sessions, and community for people starting out in street dance in the Bay.

title: Renaissance Entrepreneurship Center
who: Artists running or starting a small business
what: Small-business training and support with San Francisco locations in SoMa and the Bayview. Recommended in the room by Sharon Zimmerman for individual classes.

title: Decentered's Bay Area Survival Guide
who: Artists getting by in the Bay
what: Decentered Arts' guide to resources for making it work here, shared at the October meetup.

title: Sharon Z Consulting: business advising for artists
who: Makers and artists who want help running the business side
what: Individual consulting from Sharon Zimmerman, a jewelry artist and business coach. Group classes (around 20 to 25 people, such as networking) are under consideration.

title: Decentered Event Tracker
who: Anyone looking for indie art events, or listing one
what: A community calendar of independent art events around the Bay, run by Decentered Arts.

title: Open Ballot: compare voter guides
what: Compare endorsements across voter guides side by side for the Nov 3, 2026 California general election.

title: EACH WhatsApp community
what: Where offers and asks from the room live: lessons, gear, studio space, advice. Post what you have, ask for what you need.
